description: Both previously-disabled ATVs (the one mired in mud on Sol 7, whose flat tire was discovered on Sol 8 -- see FMARS-C19-2026-EVT006 -- and the separate breakdown from Sol 8, FMARS-C19-2026-EVT007) were successfully retrieved and returned to the hab on the mission's last full sim day.
response: Morning team retrieved the flat-tired ATV from the crater center; the second, nearer broken-down ATV was retrieved by the full crew later in the day.
source_citation: SRC-fmars-c19-2026-mission-updates, sol-9 report: 'we successfully resolved the multi-day saga of the wayward ATVs...At the end of the day we all came together as a crew to finish rescuing the last rover. All rovers are now back safely in the hab, thanks to problem solving, creativity, elbow grease, and as always, lots of teamwork.'
